messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected for streaming-route /v1/stream (SLOs) — starting 1767777700. Auto-paging oncall.
kate_oncall_sre: I’m on it. grabbing graphs now. seeing a large tail spike starting ~1767777600 -> p99 ~3.8s from baseline 1.1s. streaming stalls and many 'kv-miss' decryption timings high.
chen_ml: we shipped a quantization calibration profile (int8 aggressive) to canary yesterday and flipped to rollout 02:10 UTC (traffic split 25/75). I’m worried this matches the time window.
omar_platform: confirm: recent rollout id: calib-2026-03-15-int8-v3. config: aggressive per-head scaling + new re-order kernel. Link: https://console.internal/rollouts/calib-2026-03-15
kate_oncall_sre: can you paste the rollout id and how to revert quickly?
chen_ml: revert is via the feature-flag API or promote fallback model variant (fp8-safe). quick commands below.
deploy-bot: deploy event: calib-2026-03-15-int8-v3 -> promoted -> 02:10:22 UTC by chen_ml
kate_oncall_sre: first triage notes:
- symptom: streaming stalls (client side partial frames) and long tail on p95->p99
- affected: hosted cluster eu-west-1, model family redwood-open-l-large
- error patterns: worker deq CPU spikes + KV cache serialization latencies
- tentative root: dequant path regression after calibration change
omar_platform: metrics dump (short):
```
node_group: gw-stream-1
cpu: 85% -> 98% on deq-worker
gpu_util: stable 70%
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.12 -> 0.34
stream_conn_wait_us_p99: 2.1s -> 4.0s
```
chen_ml: logs from a misbehaving worker (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T02:14:03Z] worker-52 WARNING deq: large-dequant-duration=2100ms, key=chat/kv/abcd
[2026-03-15T02:14:03Z] worker-52 ERROR quant: calib-apply failed shard=7 fallback=true
```
kate_oncall_sre: impact assessment: p99 > SLO for last 18m, some customers on streaming noticed stalls and client timeouts. We should treat as P1 and page CS/PM.
jules_cs: notified at 02:18 UTC. collecting customer reports. initial customer sample: 3 enterprise tenants reported timeouts in session playback and streaming endpoints returning partial frames.
anya_pm: logging customer-impact now. prioritizing rollback if it reduces risk to SLAs.
kate_oncall_sre: mitigation options (proposed):
1) Immediate: flip rollout back to previous calibration profile (int8-v2) via rollback API — fastest.
2) Promote fallback model variant (fp8-safe) for streaming-route for affected customers.
3) Increase worker pool for streaming and enable temporary rate-limiter at edge to shed heavy long-context requests.
chen_ml: I can trigger the rollback. rollback command:
```
curl -XPOST "https://console.internal/api/rollouts/revert" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"rollout_id":"calib-2026-03-15-int8-v3","target":"calib-int8-v2","reason":"live tail stall P1"}'
```
omar_platform: I'll pre-scale stream pool by +30% (gw-stream-1 autoscale override) while rollback proceeds.
deploy-bot: rollback job started by chen_ml @ 1767777801
kate_oncall_sre: enabling edge per-route throttling at 02:20:10 UTC to reduce amplification from long-context traffic (config snippet):
```
route: /v1/stream
throttle: rate=100r/s burst=200
criteria: client_context_len > 1024
```
chen_ml: rollback completed: rollout reverted to calib-int8-v2 @ 1767777835 — monitoring now. :white_check_mark:
omar_platform: stream pool scaled +30% @ 1767777840. edge throttle enabled.
kate_oncall_sre: metrics update 5m after rollback:
- p95: 0.95s (baseline 0.9s)
- p99: 1.25s (baseline 1.1s) -> drop from 3.8s
- stream_conn_wait_us_p99: 4.0s -> 1.1s
- kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.34 -> 0.13
chen_ml: rollback removed the dequant hot-path. we still see a small residual increase in cpu on deq-worker for a few hosts; likely warmed caches and in-flight requests.
jules_cs: notified customers at 02:30 UTC about mitigation and rollback. watching for follow-ups.
anya_pm: immediate mitigation successful. customers reporting recovery. create a postmortem and remediation actions.
kate_oncall_sre: next steps (action items):
- infra: run full sweep to drain and restart affected workers (omar_platform)
- ml: run tighter canary gating and add low-load long-context regression tests to calibration pipeline (chen_ml)
- product: update rollout policy to require staged kernel smoke tests before >10% traffic flip (anya_pm)
- devex: add alert for kv_cache_miss_rate spike correlated with dequant durations
omar_platform: will drain+restart affected host set now. command: `./infra/drain.sh gw-stream-1 --selector deq-worker=true`
chen_ml: I'll add regression test to CI and block rollouts that increase p99 > 1.3x on synthetic long-context harness.
kate_oncall_sre: open incident channel for postmortem: #incident-1767777777-pm. start time 1767777600, mitigation complete 1767777840.
deploy-bot: post-deploy check: all streaming routes stabilized. health-checks OK.
jules_cs: closing customer notifications after no further reports.
anya_pm: assigning owners for follow-ups: chen_ml (calib pipeline), omar_platform (restart+scaling safeguards), kate_oncall_sre (postmortem), jules_cs (customer follow-up).
kate_oncall_sre: handing off oncall to @omar_platform at 1767777899. leaving notes in #oncall-runbook. final status: P1-> mitigated, rollback done, monitoring green. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) — duration 23m (1767777600 -> 1767777840). Postmortem requested.
